verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only the HTTP API, client libraries, a Postman collection, llms.txt and an MCP server, none of which is a CLI. The `ddtrace-run` command is an instrumentation launcher for the tracing SDK, not a CLI for working with the platform, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
